inputKind: a String of at most twelve characters, each one of ( ) [ ] (it may be empty)

tasks.prompt: Leave the greatest nesting depth: the largest number of brackets (of either kind) open at once while reading left to right (0 for the empty String).
tasks.reference: CHARS [ 'C' BIND C '(' EQ NOT C '[' EQ NOT AND NOT ] MAP 'O' BIND 1 -1 O SELECT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD

tasks.prompt: Leave TRUE when every bracket is closed by a bracket of the same kind in properly nested order, and FALSE otherwise (the empty String is balanced).
tasks.reference: 'S' BIND 1 S CHARS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR 1 MAX RANGE S [ 'E' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD '' EQ

tasks.prompt: Leave the length of the longest prefix of the String that is balanced in the sense of brackets.balanced (0 when only the empty prefix is).
tasks.reference: CHARS 'C' BIND 0 C LENGTH RANGE [ 'K' BIND C K TAKE JOIN 'S' BIND 1 S CHARS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR 1 MAX RANGE S [ 'E' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD '' EQ ] FILTER -1 GET

tasks.prompt: Leave how many characters remain after repeatedly deleting adjacent matched pairs "()" and "[]" until none is left.
tasks.reference: 'S' BIND 1 S CHARS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR 1 MAX RANGE S [ 'E' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD CHARS LENGTH
